name: ainet_alloc
description: AINet::Alloc allocates and zeroes an AINet record, appends it to the global AINet list, and maintains the head/tail globals.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification passes under the /MD CRT import-call profile; g_AINetListHead and g_AINetListTail are zero-initialized BSS globals in Binary Ninja/original data and source.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x402ff0 validates malloc(0x58), zeroing 0x16 dwords, first-node assignment to g_AINetListHead and g_AINetListTail, subsequent append through old tail->next at offset 0x54, tail update, and return of the allocated AINet pointer.
The native smoke verifies first and second allocation, head/tail linkage, zeroed nodeListHead fields, null next on the new tail, and cleanup through AINet::FreeAll.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x402ff0 --build-root build\vc5-verify-402ff0-md passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches after 24 relocation-masked bytes under vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs; BN size 68, VC object symbol size 80, 12 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed.
